config.NextSeasonSeeds.name: Next season's seeds on day 28
config.NextSeasonSeeds.description: On the last day of spring, summer and fall, Pierre and JojaMart also sell the next season's seeds.
config.SprinklerUpgradeRecipes.name: Sprinkler upgrade recipes
config.SprinklerUpgradeRecipes.descripti: Craft a Quality Sprinkler from a Sprinkler, and an Iridium Sprinkler from a Quality Sprinkler. Note: each recipe you know counts toward Craft Master and Perfection.
config.SiloUpgrades.name: Silo upgrades
config.SiloUpgrades.description: Robin can upgrade a Silo to a Big Silo (500 hay), then to a Deluxe Silo (750 hay). Turning this off with upgraded silos on the farm leaves them without data.
building.bigSilo.name: Big Silo
building.bigSilo.description: A sturdier silo that stores up to 500 pieces of hay.
building.deluxeSilo.name: Deluxe Silo
building.deluxeSilo.description: A reinforced silo that stores up to 750 pieces of hay.
mail.weddingTomorrow: Dear @,^^Your wedding is tomorrow! The ceremony begins as soon as you wake up, so whatever you're wearing when you go to bed tonight is what you'll be married in.^^Everyone in town is looking forward to it.^^   -Mayor Lewis[#]Your Wedding Day
config.MinecartStops.name: Minecart stops at the Forest and Beach
config.MinecartStops.description: Adds minecart stops in Cindersap Forest (near the farm) and on the Beach (at the end of the path from town). Uses the same network as the other carts, opened by the Boiler Room.
config.FountainWater.name: Fill the watering can at the town fountain
config.FountainWater.description: The fountain in Pelican Town refills your watering can, except in winter.
config.SiloPainting.name: Paint the silo
config.SiloPainting.description: Robin can paint silos, including Big and Deluxe Silos. You can color the walls, the dome and the ring under it separately.
mail.birthdayAsk: Dear @,^^I keep a calendar of everyone's birthdays by Pierre's shop, so the town never misses one. I realized I don't have yours! Tell me the date and I'll add it.^^   -Mayor Lewis[#]For the Town Calendar
mail.birthday.Mom: Dear @,^^Happy birthday, sweetheart! I baked your favorite cake. I hope the farm is treating you well and that you're eating properly.^^Love, Mom %item id (O)221 1 %%[#]Happy Birthday from Mom
mail.birthday.Dad: Dear @,^^Happy birthday, kiddo. I'm proud of you for taking on Grandpa's farm. Treat yourself to something nice.^^Love, Dad %item money 500 501 %%[#]Happy Birthday from Dad
mail.birthday.Lewis: @,^^Happy birthday from all of us at the mayor's office! Your grandfather would be proud of what you've done with the farm.^^   -Mayor Lewis %item money 500 501 %%[#]Birthday Wishes
mail.birthday.Evelyn: Dear @,^^Happy birthday, dear! I baked you a chocolate cake. George says hello too, in his own way.^^   -Evelyn %item id (O)220 1 %%[#]A Cake for You
mail.birthday.Gus: @!^^Happy birthday! Here's something hot from the Saloon kitchen. Come by tonight and your first drink is on me.^^   -Gus %item id (O)224 1 (O)213 1 (O)211 1 (O)207 1 %%[#]From the Saloon
mail.birthday.Robin: Hey @!^^Happy birthday! I had some good hardwood left over and thought of you. Let me know if you ever want something built.^^   -Robin %item id (O)709 10 %%[#]Birthday Hardwood
birthday.greeting.Lewis: Happy birthday, @! I wrote it on the town calendar myself.$h
birthday.greeting.Evelyn: Happy birthday, dear. You remind me more of your grandfather every year.$h
birthday.greeting.Gus: Well, if it isn't the birthday farmer! Stop by the Saloon tonight.$h
birthday.greeting.Robin: Happy birthday, @! Another year older and still running that whole farm. Impressive!$h
birthday.greeting.Pierre: Happy birthday! Need any seeds to celebrate? Just kidding... mostly.$h
birthday.greeting.Marnie: Happy birthday, @! Even the cows seem cheerful today.$h
birthday.greeting.Linus: Lewis told me it's your birthday. The mountain wishes you well, and so do I.$h
birthday.greeting.Willy: Happy birthday, @. My Pappy always said a birthday's a fine day to cast a line.$h
birthday.greeting.Clint: Oh... uh, happy birthday. Gus mentioned it. Hope it's a good one.
birthday.greeting.Wizard: I foresaw that today marks the day of your birth. Many happy returns, young one.
birthday.greeting.Penny: Happy birthday, @! Jas and Vincent are making you a card. They're still working on it.$h
birthday.greeting.Vincent: It's your birthday? Are you having cake? Can I have some?$h
